main_measure.name: mean signed (short) excess 5-bar return at grid bars where a short bet starts
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: t <= -2; fewer than 30 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean signed excess fall, larger |forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The t of the mean signed excess fall lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are the bars at positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window on which a short bet starts (a fall of the forecast of at least 2 points below its least-negative level since the last bet, reset at flat), the excess is against the coin's mean 5-bar grid return over all its windows, and the median split puts cases with |forecast| above the median in the larger half and the rest in the smaller.
